records.title: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The method adjusts trust regions using policy staleness to stabilize asynchronous reinforcement-learning updates and reports training stability/throughput in RL experiments. It changes training synchronization, not LLM serving/scheduling; no inference latency, memory, or throughput result applies to the lineage.

records.title: CHIA: An open-source framework for principled, agentic AI-driven hardware/software co-design research
records.reason: CHIA is an open-source agentic hardware/software co-design research framework with workflows and case studies. Evaluation demonstrates the framework on co-design tasks, not a specific LLM serving optimization or measured inference improvement; findings depend on the selected design space/toolchain.
